entities.name: Isidro Goma y Tomas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isidro Gomá y Tomás was the Bishop of Tarazona in the Province of Zaragoza and was known for his strong support of Francisco Franco and the National Movement during the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939). He was later made Cardinal and Archbishop of Toledo and was Primate of Spain.
